title: Moon Shadow Kimi Secures $3.5 Billion in Series F Funding, Valuation Rises to $35 Billion, Series G Financing Has Already Started in Advance

content_html:
Kimi, a subsidiary of Moonshot, has completed its Series F funding round, with the amount exceeding 3.5 billion USD, and the post-money valuation has risen to 35 billion USD. Due to the subscription volume being more than three times the original target, this funding round was closed ahead of schedule, with the enthusiasm of the funds closing earlier than planned.

The pace is even tighter ahead. The Series G (pre-IPO) round, originally scheduled to start in August, has already begun early, with the pre-money valuation raised to 50 billion USD. From the conclusion of the Series F round to the start of the Series G round, there was almost no pause — the capital's pursuit of the company is accelerating by the month. When one round of financing closes early due to oversubscription and the next round quickly follows, Kimi's value in the primary market is climbing along a steep curve.

content_html_zh:
Moonshot旗下Kimi已完成F轮融资，金额超过35亿美元，投后估值已升至350亿美元。 由于认购量超过原定目标的三倍，本轮融资提前结束，资金热情早于计划结束。

前方的步伐更加紧迫。 原定于8月启动的G轮（IPO前）已提前启动，投前估值升至500亿美元。 从F轮结束到G轮启动，几乎没有任何停顿——资本对公司的追捧逐月加速。 当一轮融资因超额认购而提前结束并且下一轮融资很快跟进时，Kimi 在一级市场的价值正在沿着陡峭的曲线攀升。
